chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from a number of our companions from Muhammad ibn al-Hamid from Abu Khalid, the freedman of Ali ibn Yaqtin, said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the Mufrid al-Hajj, does he have the Tawaf al-Nisa' upon him? He said: 'There is no Tawaf al-Nisa' upon him.'

Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: This report is not acted upon, because that which there is no disagreement about among the sect is that Tawaf al-Nisa' is necessary in all other types of Hajj and in Umrah as well.

key_terms.الطَّائِفَةِ: Al-Ta'ifah: The Shia sect or scholarly community
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ: Umrah: The minor pilgrimage to Mecca
key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa': The eighth circumambulation of the Kaaba, performed after the seven circuits of Tawaf al-Fard
key_terms.مُفْرِدِ الْحَجِّ: Mufrid al-Hajj: A pilgrim who performs Hajj al-Mufrid (Hajj alone) without combining it with Umrah

ai.seo_question: Is Tawaf al-Nisa' obligatory for Mufrid al-Hajj according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the jurisprudential tension between a specific report from Imam al-Rida (AS) and the prevailing consensus (*ijma'*) of the Shia sect regarding the necessity of Tawaf al-Nisa' for the Mufrid al-Hajj. Although the Imam explicitly exempted the Muid from this ritual, the scholar Muhammad ibn al-Hasan clarifies that this report is considered *ghayr ma'mul bihi* (not acted upon) because the majority view mandates Tawaf al-Nisa' as an integral part of all Hajj and Umrah forms. This reflects the Shia methodology of prioritizing widespread consensus over isolated reports when determining practical legal rulings.
